name: Shenzhen Anycubic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen printer maker founded 2015 by Lu Ouyang (CEO) and James Ouyang, operating in both FDM (Kobra series) and resin/SLA. Sells house-brand filament and resin alongside its hardware. Whether Anycubic extrudes filament itself or contracts it out is unresolved: a single low-confidence company-profile source names eSUN as a filament supplier, but this is uncorroborated and absent from the owner-verified ground-truth table, so no OEM relationship is encoded.

product_lines.name: PLA Basic / PLA Basic Refill
product_lines.notes: Standard PLA; Refill is a spool-less reload of the same resin

product_lines.name: PLA Special
product_lines.notes: Not a distinct chemistry - confirmed to be PLA Basic in special/limited colourways

product_lines.name: PLA High Speed
product_lines.notes: High-flow PLA tuned for fast printers

product_lines.name: PLA Silk / PLA Silk Dual & Tri-Color
product_lines.notes: Gloss-additive PLA; dual/tri-colour variants are coextruded strands, chemistry unchanged

product_lines.name: PLA Galaxy
product_lines.notes: PLA with glitter particulate; no dedicated glitter-PLA id in catalog

product_lines.name: PLA Marble
product_lines.notes: PLA with mineral marble-effect filler; no dedicated marble id in catalog

product_lines.name: PC
product_lines.notes: Unfilled polycarbonate; 270-290 C nozzle range consistent with unfilled PC

product_lines.name: TPU 68D
product_lines.notes: Shore 68D (Shore D scale) semi-rigid TPU marketed as a soft-hard hybrid, high-speed and wear-resistant - the uncommon rigid grade, not an 85A/95A Shore-A generic

additional_notes: The 2026 filament catalog is broader than earlier passes recorded: no nylon/PA line is offered, and the carbon-fibre SKUs resolve to PLA-CF and PETG-CF. Also runs a substantial UV resin business for its SLA printers, which is out of scope for this filament catalog. Sells PEI Spring Steel Magnetic Platforms and a double-sided smooth PEI plate for the Kobra series. Regional storefronts include eu.anycubic.com and anycubic.biz. Social profiles on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, X and Reddit exist but exact handles were not verified, so none are recorded.

provenance.conflicts: One secondary company-profile source (CB Insights) describes eSUN as an Anycubic filament supplier. This is a single low-confidence source, is not corroborated elsewhere, and does not appear in the owner-verified ground-truth table, so no oem_relationship was encoded. Open question: whether Anycubic filament is produced in-house or contract-manufactured.
